nodes.title: Prepare stop calling
nodes.comment: A person. Two ways, as the handover specialist expects them. (a) The customer asks for something it owns (a person, a manager, a complaint, a chase, do not call, how did you get my number): the summary goes with the call and no reason code, so it works out which of its own requests this is from the conversation and keeps the summary. A manager request then becomes a manager callback, and "stop calling me" is recorded and confirmed there. (b) The AI agent could not go on: a reason code and a summary go with the call, and it is passed to a person. What the customer said comes first in the summary. Nothing is said before the call is passed on: the handover specialist speaks. "Stop calling me": this call closes on do_not_call whatever it had earned before.

nodes.title: System failure
nodes.detail: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now.
nodes.say: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now.
nodes.comment: A system did not answer, or the model failed after its one retry (ON_ERROR): say so once, in the shared wording, and pass the call to a person. The line promises nothing: the handover specialist says the connecting line. The steps that come here set the reason and the summary first; a model failure arrives with neither, and gets the two below.

nodes.title: Prepare person with reason
nodes.detail: Sets handover_reason, handover_summary, disposition_code, disposition_notes, after_log

nodes.title: Disposition code ≠ logged code?
nodes.comment: ---- 14. Writing the disposition, and what follows it (P11) ------------------------------- The code is written as soon as the call has earned it, and written again only if it changes. It goes with the number called, the dialler's record of the call, the booking or enquiry the call is about, the purpose and, for a call back, the time asked for. A write that fails or is refused never keeps the customer waiting, and it is not marked as written, so the next outcome of the call writes the code again. Nothing is retried blindly. The answer of an earlier write is dropped before every new one. A call can write several codes, and a write that fails must not be marked as written because an earlier write succeeded.

cases.when: Is called by the AI agent for any reason
cases.agent_does: Checks Do Not Call before every call. Every call ends on today’s disposition codes.

nodes.title: After log = sorry or after log = wrong number?
After log = no answer?

nodes.title: Raise safety
nodes.comment: The two escapes. Each flag is set in the step that hands off, and nowhere else: the step hands the call over itself and has no next step. The safety note, or the summary and the reason code, are already set by the steps before.

nodes.title: Say confirmed
nodes.detail: Thank you, we look forward to seeing you. Goodbye.
nodes.say: Thank you, we look forward to seeing you. Goodbye.
nodes.comment: The last lines. This agent closes its own calls: it is the entry agent of the outbound deployment and there is no front desk behind it.
